data.summary:
This **FORTIFICATION**'s sections work as follows:

- 1 friendly **MONOLITH**, **OBELISK**, **TESSERACT VAULT** or **SENTRY PYLON** model may begin the battle on its ziggurat platform
- while that model is on the ziggurat platform, its ranged weapons have **[HEAVY]**
- any friendly model may be set up on, or end any kind of move on, its ramps or platform sections
